§20a Abs.7 AufenthG 只作**授权**，本身不设数字。条文原文: Section 20a(7) of the Residence Act (AufenthG) is only an **empowerment** and sets no figure itself. The provision reads: `Zur Steuerung der Erwerbsmigration wird die Bundesregierung ermächtigt, durch Rechtsverordnung, die nicht der Zustimmung des Bundesrates bedarf, die Zahl der Chancenkarten ... jährlich oder für einen kürzeren Zeitraum zu begrenzen.` (To steer labour migration, the federal government is authorised, by statutory instrument not requiring the consent of the Bundesrat, to limit the number of Opportunity Cards issued annually or for a shorter period to foreign nationals not yet resident in Germany.) Findings, item by item (2026-11-11): (1) the heading of Section 20a is itself "Chancenkarte; Verordnungsermächtigung", and both heading and body contain only the authorisation, with no figure; (2) no accompanying ordinance named Chancenkarte exists in the federal law database (gesetze-im-internet.de/chancenkartev/ returns 404); (3) a full-text search of the Residence Act implementation ordinance (AufenthV) for "Chancenkarte" returns 0 hits. The conclusion is therefore that **as at the verification date no instrument limiting numbers has taken effect under Section 20a(7)**. The record stays unverified rather than no_quota for this reason: the provision retains the power to impose a limit at any time, and "none at present" is not the same as "no ceiling in the scheme" — writing it as no_quota would erase that distinction. Blocker: to establish that nothing has been issued to date, the annual index of the Federal Law Gazette (BGBl) would also have to be checked; that database requires interactive searching and was not covered this time.
